Vol. 1 No. 56 (2026): The Peer-reviewed Journal of the Jurisprudence Faculty

This volume contains (13) research papers, which vary in the fields of: Qur’anic and Hadith sciences, Arabic language and literature, philosophy, law, history, contemporary jurisprudence, theology, Islamic thought, and comparative religions.

  Journal of Jurisprudence Faculty  -  ISSN (Online): 3080-1435 / (Print): 1995-7971

 A quarterly peer-reviewed scientific journal issued by Faculty  of Jurisprudence/University of Kufa/ Iraq, concerned with publishing solid scientific research related to various Islamic, Religions, Human and Social sciences that have not been published, or have been submitted for publication, previously.

DOI: https://doi.org/10.36324/fqhj.v1i56
Published: 30-09-2026
